title: Cosmic Horse Painter
description: A brown horse wearing glasses and an apron sits on stone ruins, painting swirling galaxies and planets with a large brush onto a sketchbook. An arched stone window with a colorful stained glass design stands behind it, while numerous glowing cosmic orbs and galaxies float in the fiery orange sky.
prompt: A brown horse with glasses and a white shirt with orange apron sits on broken stone ruins, intently painting colorful galaxies and planets into a sketchbook using a large paintbrush. Behind the horse is a crumbling stone arch with vibrant stained glass. The dramatic sky is filled with swirling orange clouds and dozens of glowing, floating cosmic orbs and spiral galaxies in vibrant colors, surreal fantasy scene.
